 Search The Site Rochester Stores Are Offering Thanksgiving Meals for Under $39 Rochester Stores Are Offering Thanksgiving Meals for Under $39
 Carly Ross Carly Ross Published: November 3, 2026 Getty Images Share on Facebook 
 Share on Twitter 
 You know what's expensive? Well, everything, yes, but feeding everyone for Thanksgiving is expensive, that's what I was getting at. And with Thanksgiving around the corner, plans are starting to be made, including when it comes to the food.
 But if you're worried about the cost of this year's Thanksgiving meal, never fear, there are grocery stores in Rochester that have Thanksgiving deals so you can feed everyone but still stay on budget.
 ALSO READ: Thanksgiving is Predicted to be Cold Across Minnesota 
 One thing I will point out, and maybe I'm the only one that didn't realize this, but just in case, these deals are not pre-packaged for you. The stores just provide a shopping list of their products to put together a great Thanksgiving meal at an affordable price. So you do still have to shop around the store.
 Rochester Grocery Stores with Thanksgiving Meal Deals, 2026
 Aldi - 10 people for under $39
 What's in the meal deal: 
 Whole Turkey
 Chef's Cupboard Stuffing Mix (3)
 Baby Peeled Carrots
 Celery
 Cranberries (12 oz)
 Sweet Potatoes (3 lb)
 L'oven Fresh Hawaiian Sweet Rolls
 Season's Choice Steamable Frozen Peas (2)
 Baker's Corner Pumpkin Pie Mix (this won't be available in stores until Nov. 11th)
 Bake House Creations Pie Crusts
 Friendly Farms Whole Milk
 Friendly Farms Heavy Whipping Cream
 HyVee - 10 people for under $35

 Hy-Vee Frozen Turkey (up to 12 lbs.)

 Fresh Sweet Potatoes (three potatoes)

 Hy-Vee Gravy Mix (two packets)
 Hy-Vee Stuffing Mix (two 6-oz. boxes)
 Hy-Vee Pumpkin (one 15-oz. can)
 Hy-Vee Evaporated Milk (one 12-oz. can)
 Hy-Vee Frozen Pie Crust
